question: What claim of immunity is made about poison entering the body even in the case of being bitten by great serpents?
premises: Poison is the subject in question.
It is said not to enter the body.
This is stated even if one has been bitten.
The biting is by great serpents.
inference: Poison does not enter the body even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
uncertainties: The basis for this immunity is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
